predictions.quote: You're going to run for governor again. Assume that's going to be a shoe-in. You know, you got to do the work, but
predictions.prediction: Jason predicts Josh Shapiro's 2026 re-election bid for Pennsylvania governor will be a near-certain win ("a shoe-in").

predictions.quote: I've got 500,000 Pennsylvanians who are going to lose their health care. I've got 120,000 who have already lost their health care. About another 320,000 or so were likely to lose Medicaid next year.
predictions.prediction: Shapiro predicts about 320,000 additional Pennsylvanians will lose Medicaid coverage next year (2027) due to federal cuts from Trump's budget bill, bringing the total number of Pennsylvanians losing health care to roughly 500,000.

predictions.quote: I've got 26 rural hospitals that are likely to shutter because these are rural hospitals that are working at an operating deficit and they're relying so much on Medicaid which has been slashed by the federal government.
predictions.prediction: Shapiro predicts 26 rural hospitals in Pennsylvania are likely to close due to operating deficits worsened by federal Medicaid cuts.

predictions.quote: Probably years before those gas prices come down even if the war, you know, hopefully ends, you know, very very soon.
predictions.prediction: Shapiro predicts it will likely take years for gas prices to come back down, even if the Israel-Iran war ends soon.
